svg.text: CURRENT PAGE IS A SPAN; LINKS ARE ANCHORS.
NO OUTER SURFACE, BORDER OR SHADOW.
ALL LABEL WIDTHS ARE HUG; PLAN IS SCHEMATIC.
CALLER CHOOSES WHICH MIDDLE ITEMS TO HIDE.
ELLIPSIS HIT AREA EXCEEDS ITS VISIBLE BOX.
SIBLING HIT AREA EXTENDS VERTICALLY ONLY.
MENU ROWS USE THE SHARED DROPDOWN PANEL.
CURRENT ROW OR FIRST ENABLED ROW IS ACTIVE.
FIXED GEOMETRY 2:1 · MD · HUG WIDTHS PROPORTIONAL
VISIBLE SEQUENCE: LINK / SEPARATOR / ELLIPSIS / SEPARATOR / CURRENT.
S1 APPLIES BETWEEN EVERY FLEX CHILD; CURRENT HAS NO EXTRA PAD-X.
NEGATIVE MARGIN CANCELS BOTH S3 INSETS IN FLOW.
FOCUS RING IS F1 OUTSIDE THE R1 ROUNDED BOX.
NO SIDEWAYS EXPANSION OVER THE LINK.
NO SCRIM, CONTAINER FILL OR ELEVATION IN THE TRAIL.
OPTIONAL MENU PORTAL IS A SEPARATE SURFACE.
DURING EXPANSION: NOWRAP + CLIP, THEN RESTORE.
W = AVAILABLE CALLER SPACE; WRAPPED HEIGHT = HUG.
CURRENT SIBLING GETS A TRAILING MARK.
BOTTOM / START; MAY FLIP OR SHIFT.
MENU ROW R4 IS NOT CONCENTRIC WITH R3.
R5 IS REFERENCE ONLY, NOT IMPLEMENTED.
Inspector + usage reference reviewed; browser default md measured.
